widgets_values: ADD WATER. Heavy rain falls over the whole scene. Every surface is wet and reflects the light, and puddles cover the ground.
nodes.title: End-frame prompt

widgets_values: For the first second the video matches the photo exactly.

Rain starts to fall over the whole scene. Drops streak down past the subject, the ground turns dark and wet, puddles spread, and small splashes jump where the drops land. Every surface starts to shine with reflections.
The sound is steady rain, with drops tapping on the ground. The camera stays fixed. The subject keeps the same shape, face and clothes as in the photo.

nodes.title: Effects: one photo to a short effect video on LTX 2.5
widgets_values:
# Effects: one photo to a short effect video on LTX 2.5

Locks your photo at frame 0, makes a matte of its subject, builds an end frame for the effect and renders one continuous shot in two stages. This file holds the rain recipe: an end frame from the Water-Simulation IC-LoRA and the photo held at the last frame through the subject matte. The other 7 recipes change it in the catalog.
